word.answer: Yes. Speakur provides {{priceLabel}} pronunciation lookup for “{{name}}” in {{year}}. IPA text is server-rendered in HTML, and audio generates only after you click Play—keeping pages fast while staying free for learners and creators.

guide.answer: Read the guide at {{url}}, note any tricky terms, then look them up in Speakur’s {{priceLabel}} pronunciation search. Each word page shows IPA, syllable cues, and click-to-play US/UK audio so you can hear terminology aloud while studying the topic.

faq.question: How does AI speech synthesis work in simple terms?
faq.answer: AI speech synthesis converts text into audible speech using models trained on recorded voice data. Modern systems predict acoustic features or waveforms, then a vocoder renders the final clip. Speakur uses synthesis only after you click Play, then caches audio so repeat listens stay fast and free.

faq.question: Is AI-generated pronunciation audio free on Speakur?
faq.answer: Speakur prioritizes free dictionary clips when they exist. If no clip is available, click-gated TTS generates audio on demand and caches it—avoiding cost on every page view while keeping playback free for users in 2026.
